description: Projection of the saved 20261027T065112Z controller observation repair. Exact before/after check bindings and unrelated source contract/wiring evidence; not a compilable architecture or semantic approval.

command_engine.reset: Clear active request, candidate, and refresh preparation state. Suppress dispatch_ready, candidate_valid, and commit_valid while reset is asserted. Invalid command payload is canonical NOP.

update_events.shared.events.dispatch: Capture the complete dispatch request into active ownership. Candidate generation begins only on a later edge.
update_events.shared.events.command_commit: After ACT or PRE, retain active ownership and form a later candidate from updated state. After final READ or WRITE, retire active ownership. During refresh preparation, committed PRE advances ascending bank preparation and committed REF completes one refresh acknowledgment.
update_events.every_clock: When no candidate is outstanding, refresh is not in service, and reset is inactive, derive the next registered candidate from active ownership, bank state, and refresh preparation. A visible refresh pending level blocks new dispatch and is serviced only after active work drains.

simultaneous_events.refresh_due_and_final_commit: The final active command may commit using pre-edge refresh state; pending becomes visible afterward and blocks later dispatch.
simultaneous_events.retirement_and_dispatch: Retirement does not permit same-edge replacement dispatch.
simultaneous_events.refresh_pending_and_dispatch: A pre-edge visible pending refresh prevents dispatch.

refresh.reset: Clear deadline, pending, and service state synchronously. pending and service_busy are reset-gated low.

update_events.shared.events.refresh_due: Set pending and advance the periodic deadline by tREFI.
update_events.shared.events.refresh_start: Start tRFC service and clear pending unless refresh_due also occurs on the same edge.
update_events.shared.events.refresh_end: End service exclusion while preserving independently accumulated pending state.

simultaneous_events.due_and_refresh_start: Due wins pending-state update; REF starts service and another pending refresh remains.
simultaneous_events.due_and_refresh_end: Service ends but pending remains set.

execution.verification.V_EXEC_COMMAND_CO.note: Verify only a legal permitted candidate commits and blocked candidates have no observable effect.

after_check.note: Probe candidate signals as the indirect timing-history check. For blocked WRITE cases, retain attempted address/data in an independent memory scoreboard and subsequently issue/read back the affected location to prove no mutation. Observe refresh pending/service state and response outputs to prove blocked proposals produce no refresh or response side effect.
